title: Megurine Luka — The Madly Envious Tailor〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Court of Law

rows.Speaker: Government Official
rows.Line: All rise!

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Kayo Sudou...

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: You stand here today to face charges for the murders of Mirokuya and Mei. How do you plead?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Guilty, your honor.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Care to explain why?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: She came between my husband and myself.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: And you are also the one behind what happened to Mei's daughter, Miku, as well as her sister, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Guilty, your honor.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: She came between my husband and myself.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Anything further...?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: No, your honor.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (No matter how many times anybody asks, my answer will not change...)

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (The rest of what I know will go with me to the grave...)
One year earlier
Enbizaka

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (I have not been sleeping well as of late... I may be more fatigued than I realize...)

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Regardless, I must deliver the kimono that the soba restaurant ordered...

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner A
rows.Line: Hey, it's that tailor...

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner B
rows.Line: The one that got caught in that fire four years ago? I remember her getting treated for those horrible burns, but I guess she's back.

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: Looks like it. But she seems so frightening now...

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: I was out with my kids the other day and happened to run into her, but she began leering at us for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner A
rows.Line: Hold on, you sure you didn't do anything to her?

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: No, of course not! We were just minding our own business when it happened.

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: Losing her “family” may have made her jealous of others who've managed to find happiness...

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: I even heard that she'd finally lost it. Rumor has it that she speaks as if her husband and son are still alive when no one is around.

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner B
rows.Line:
I heard that too...
Something about her kid working for that Perrié guy at his shop, right?

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line:
Yes, that.
And how her husband is always out and never home.

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner
rows.Line:
Poor thing...
If only that fire had never happened...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Phew. Delivered as ordered.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (But I still have plenty of other orders still unfinished. I should head home and...)

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
Well, if it isn't Kayo!
Out delivering a kimono?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Oh, Oyuka. Good evening.
Yes, I was just delivering a kimono to the soba restaurant.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Look at you. Already hard at work just after coming back. Eikichi could learn so much from you.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Eikichi...? Oh, the private detective?
You are both from the same village, yes?

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Yes, and because of that, he's got it in his mind that he can slack off and use my shop as a hideout.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you get him to find the perp that started that fire four years ago?

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
Oh... I'm sorry, Kayo.
I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: No need to apologize... You lost your store to that fire as well, so I know you understand.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: S-Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: You have nothing to worry about when it comes to me. After all, Oyuka, I have you to talk to.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Are you sure that's enough...?

Sorry about that...
Having you deal with one of them like this.

No, it's okay...
It was really no trouble.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Oh, it's Mirokuya and his wife, Mei.

rows.Speaker: Mei
rows.Line: I really would rather have you treat that burn instead of fussing over me so much...

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: Nonsense. Look, my fingers are moving fine now.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line:
So many were lost to that fire.
We have the gods to thank for us still being here.

rows.Speaker: Mei
rows.Line: I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: He got caught up in that fire too...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Oyuka...
Please, excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka's Voice
rows.Line:
Sure.
Come visit again soon.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Back to work...
The next day

rows.Speaker: Oyuka's Voice
rows.Line:
Kayo, it's terrible!!
How can you be sweeping like nothing's happened?!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Oyuka?
You seem startled.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Wrong doesn't even begin to describe it! Mirokuya's wife...! Mei...! She...! She's...!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Oh my...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: It happened last night. Must've been some rogue or rebel. They even took that red kimono right off her back.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: And just when I thought that things would finally go back to the way they were.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: You need to be careful out there, Kayo. Even if it's for work, it's not safe to walk around at night when there aren't any people around.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Thank you for this, Oyuka.
Please, stay safe.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
I will.
Wait... I left my shop wide open!
See you later, Kayo!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Anyway, back to work.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: I should start by doing something about this hole in the breast area.
